title: IndigoReach - Giving Wings to Fly
summary: We had a session in Guru Nanak College of Arts, Commerce & Science. Around 30 girls attended.
description:
We had a session in Guru Nanak College of Arts, Commerce & Science.
Around 30 girls attended. We have requested the coordinator to form a WhatsApp group with the interested students asap.

We were informed 30 students couldn't attend due to exams. We have requested them to call us when those students are available.
location: Guru Nanak College of Arts & Science, Mumbai, Maharashtra
